title: ClickFix attacks are tricking Mac and Windows users into hacking themselves | TechCrunch
summary: Reddit told TechCrunch it “recently learned that an HBO Max account authorized to run advertisements on Reddit was compromised and used to run ads containing malicious links,” and that the company locked the account and removed the ads.
